From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenhouse <no-reply@greenhouse.io>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hiring rubric sync + interview slots for Staff Serving Engineer

Hi team,

We have Alex Johnson (ex-InfraLead at Nimbus) in loop for the Staff Serving Engineer role and the interview loop is scheduled for next week. Before we lock panels I want a quick sync to align on:

- Role scope boundaries (operational ownership vs platform design)
- Leveling signals we expect for Staff vs Senior Staff (impact horizon, cross-team influence, architectural authorship)
- Key focus areas for each interviewer (runtime perf, deployment reliability, systems design, and team leadership context)

Attached: current rubric draft (SWE-Staff-rubric-v3.pdf) and a candidate slot sheet.

Can we either (A) align asynchronously in this thread with suggested changes to the rubric and interview matrix, or (B) quick 30m sync tomorrow AM if people prefer live discussion.

I suggest we keep the bar-raiser responsibility with Marissa for the hiring committee, and ask Vivek to own the runtime/perf evaluation, Aditya to cover system interactions & infra tradeoffs, and Lauren to cover org/leadership + hiring bar.

Thanks — Soojin

Soojin Lee
Hiring Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Greenhouse <no-reply@greenhouse.io>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hiring rubric sync + interview slots for Staff Serving Engineer

Thanks, Soojin. Quick thoughts inline: 

- Role scope: agree we should emphasize system-level ownership (service lifecycle & migration strategies) and cross-team influence (roadmaps, design reviews). Avoid conflating hands-on kernel-level optimization with expectations for every candidate — leave room for evidence of systems leadership.

- Leveling signals: add explicit items for "scale authorship" (led design that improved throughput/cost across product), and "stakeholder velocity" (ability to unstick multi-team projects). For Senior Staff we expect direct technical leadership on a single product line; for Staff we expect multiple area impact.

- Interviewers: happy to be bar-raiser. I'll add a checklist in the rubric for 3 strike categories: Impact, Technical Depth, Collaboration & Influence.

I'll propose small edits to the rubric PDF and upload a spreadsheet mapping interviewers to focus areas. If you want a live sync, 9–9:30am PT tomorrow works for me.

Marissa

Marissa Cole
Director, Site Reliability & Hiring Bar-Raiser

Subject: Re: Hiring rubric sync + interview slots for Staff Serving Engineer

Thanks — brief comments from the runtime POV: 

- Interview focus: runtime perf interview should include a short exercise on memory/kv cache design and a prep prompt (candidate has 20 minutes, then 10m discussion). I can draft the exercise.
- Signals: add evaluation for quantization/optimization tradeoffs and ability to reason about latency tail (p99/p999) with mitigation plans.
- Logistics: I can attend the 9am sync if still on. If we go async, I'll drop my suggested perf checklist in this thread by EOD.

Vivek

Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 14:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hiring rubric sync + interview slots for Staff Serving Engineer

Adding my notes from the infra-systems lens: 

- Expectation matrix: for Staff we want evidence of designing for operability (runbooks, SLO ownership, postmortem culture) across multiple services. For Senior Staff it's acceptable if operability is deep for one product.
- System interactions exercise: propose a 30-minute design prompt that includes tradeoffs between availability, consistency, and cost for a cache-sharding migration. Candidate should sketch an incremental rollout plan.
- Timing: prefer synchronous 30m tomorrow so we can finalize interview matrix and update GH stages. My calendar: free 09:00–10:00 PT.

- Small ask: Marissa, if you're bar-raising, can you confirm the minimum acceptable rubric score thresholds (Impact >= 3 and Technical Depth >= 3 on a 1–5)? We should be explicit for Greenhouse stage gating.

Cheers,
Aditya

Aditya Rao

Subject: Finalized interview matrix + confirmed slots (summary)

Thanks all for the fast responses and clear inputs — summary below for the loop and for Greenhouse. Alex, adding you so you can see the panel and what each interviewer will prioritize.

1) Interview matrix (attached: interview-matrix-2027Q1.xlsx)
- Runtime / Perf (Vivek) — exercise: KV-cache & tail-latency mitigation (20m exercise, 10m Q&A)
- Systems Design (Aditya) — 30m design prompt: sharding migration & rollout plan
- Leadership & Stakeholder Influence (Lauren) — behavioral prompt, look for metrics and adoption story
- Bar-raiser deep-dive (Marissa) — cross-cutting: scale authorship, org influence, three-strike checklist
- Hiring coordinator / screen (Soojin) — culture fit, role scope clarification, compensation expectations (15m)

2) Leveling thresholds (Marissa confirmed): Gate requires Impact >= 3 and Technical Depth >= 3 on a 1–5 scale; bar-raiser can veto.

3) Logistics: Final panel locked for Tue 23 Feb 2027. Candidate received calendar invite (candidate-slot-availability.ics) and GH stage updated.

4) Deliverables before interviews:
- Vivek: perf exercise draft (EOD Mon)
- Aditya: design prompt doc (EOD Mon)
- Lauren: leadership rubric update (today by 3pm PT)
- Marissa: final rubric PDF with checklist (EOD Mon)
- Soojin: confirm compensation band to recruiting (done)

If anyone needs to swap an interviewer, flag in GH by EOD Monday so we can reassign.

Alex — welcome to the final stage. We'll keep the loop concise and focused on cross-team impact + technical ownership.

Best,
Soojin
